page.title: Create a project from a document
page.description: Upload a requirements document and let AI draft the whole project: sprints, tasks, subtasks and acceptance criteria. You review and edit the plan before anything is created.
page.noAccessTitle: You cannot create projects with AI
page.noAccessBody: Creating a project and its tasks needs permission to edit projects and tasks. Ask an owner or admin of this workspace.
page.addedBody: {{tasks}} tasks in {{sprints}} sprints were added. The project's existing work was not changed.

destination.title: Where should the plan go?
destination.hint: Create a new project, or add the sprints and tasks to a project your team already uses.

new.title: Create a new project
new.body: The AI proposes the project's name, key, colour and description.

existing.title: Add to an existing project
existing.body: Only the plan's sprints, tasks, subtasks and criteria are added.

destination.noProjectsBody: Create a project first, then come back to add this plan to it.

problems.targetRequired: Choose the project this plan should be added to.
problems.targetMissing: That project is no longer available. Choose another project or create a new one.
problems.targetArchived: That project is archived. Choose another project or create a new one.

edit.hint: Press Enter to save or Escape to cancel.
edit.hintMultiline: Press Ctrl+Enter to save or Escape to cancel.

criteria.title: Acceptance criteria
criteria.missing_one: {{count}} task has no acceptance criteria yet. Add some so people know when it is done.
criteria.missing_other: {{count}} tasks have no acceptance criteria yet. Add some so people know when they are done.

sprint.backlogHint: Work that does not fit in a sprint yet. Move a task here to plan it later.
sprint.empty: No tasks here. Add one, or move a task into this sprint.

tasks.emptyBody: The plan needs at least one task. Add one, or regenerate the plan.
tasks.add: Add a task to the backlog

header.label: Generated project
header.existingHint: The plan's sprints, tasks, subtasks and criteria are added. The project's name, settings and existing work are not changed.
header.keyInvalid: The key must be 2 to 6 letters or digits.

review.partialTitle: Only part of the document was analysed
review.partialBody: The document is long ({{chars}} characters), so the middle was left out. The plan covers the beginning and the section headings. Check that nothing important is missing, or split the document and upload the parts separately.
review.hint: Read the plan, then change what you need: click a title, points or priority to edit it, move a task to another sprint, or delete and add tasks. Nothing is created until you press Create.
review.destinationNewHint: A new project is created with only this plan.
review.destinationExistingHint: The plan is added to this project without changing its settings or existing work.
review.confirmAddBody: This adds sprints, tasks, subtasks and acceptance criteria to “{{target}}”. The project's settings and existing work are not changed.
review.nameTakenTitle: A project with this name already exists
review.keyTakenTitle: This project key is already used
review.problemsTitle_one: {{count}} thing to fix before you can create the project
review.problemsTitle_other: {{count}} things to fix before you can create the project

problems.projectKey: The project key must be 2 to 6 letters or digits.
problems.noItems: The plan needs at least one task.

review.regenerateUnavailable: The document is no longer in this tab. Discard the plan and upload it again.
review.confirmRegenerateBody: Your edits are lost and the document is sent to the AI provider again. It counts toward the daily limit.
review.confirmDiscardBody: Your edits are lost. Nothing has been created.

upload.cannotStart: We could not start the analysis
upload.dropTitle: Drop your document here, or choose a file
upload.dropHint: PDF, Word (.docx), text or Markdown, up to {{size}}

fileProblem.type: This file type is not supported. Upload a PDF, DOCX, TXT or Markdown file.
fileProblem.doc: Old Word files (.doc) are not supported. Save the document as .docx or PDF and try again.
fileProblem.size: This file is too large. The limit is {{size}}.

upload.optionsHint: All optional. The AI chooses a name, a key and the number of sprints when you leave them empty.
upload.projectNameHint: Leave empty to let the AI name it.
upload.projectKeyHint: 2 to 6 letters or digits, for task references like WEB-12.
upload.startDatePast: Choose today or a later day.
upload.teamSizeHint: Used to size the sprints. Defaults to 4 people.
upload.languageHint: Titles, descriptions and criteria are written in this language.
upload.notesHint: For example “mobile first” or “skip the admin area”. {{count}} of {{max}} characters.
upload.needTarget: Choose the project this plan should be added to.

notice.title: What happens to your document
notice.body: The text of your document is sent to {{provider}} ({{model}}), the AI provider configured for this installation, to build the plan. Nothing is sent until you press Analyze, and only when an administrator has turned AI on for this workspace.
notice.sent: Sent to the provider: the text of the document and your options. Pictures are not read.
notice.stored: Kept by TaskMan: the file name, its size, the first 2,000 characters as a preview and the plan, for {{days}} days. The document itself is never stored.
notice.untrusted: Instructions written inside the document are treated as text to plan, not as commands.
notice.unavailableTitle: AI is not set up on this server
notice.unavailableBody: An administrator of this TaskMan installation has to configure the AI provider first (AI_PROVIDER, AI_API_KEY, AI_BASE_URL and AI_MODEL on the server).
notice.offTitle: AI is turned off for this workspace
notice.offBody: Nothing leaves TaskMan until an owner or admin turns it on in the workspace settings.
notice.askAdmin: Ask an owner or admin to turn it on.
notice.limitBody: This workspace has used its {{limit}} AI project plans for today. The limit resets at midnight UTC.
notice.on: AI is on for this workspace. {{used}} of {{limit}} project plans used today.

analyzing.title: The AI is building your project

steps.readHint: Extracting the text and sending it to the AI.
steps.designHint: Grouping the work into sprints that fit your team.
steps.writeHint: Estimating, adding subtasks and testable criteria.

analyzing.truncated: The document is long, so only the beginning and the section headings are analysed.
analyzing.slowTitle: This is taking longer than usual
analyzing.slowBody: You can keep waiting, or cancel and try a shorter document.
analyzing.leave: This usually takes one to two minutes. If you leave this page, come back to it from your browser history to pick the plan up.

errors.loadFailed: We could not load the plan. Check your connection and try again.
errors.gone: This plan no longer exists. It may have been deleted or expired.
errors.uploadFailed: We could not upload the document. Check your connection and try again.
errors.cancelFailed: We could not cancel. Try again.
errors.createFailed: We could not create the project. Nothing was changed. Try again.
errors.rateLimited: Too many requests. Wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.network: We could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.

codes.FILE_TOO_LARGE: The file is too large. Use a smaller file or split the document.
codes.UNSUPPORTED_TYPE: This file is not a PDF, DOCX, TXT or Markdown document, or it is damaged.
codes.EMPTY_DOCUMENT: No readable text was found. A scanned PDF needs text recognition (OCR) first.
codes.UNREADABLE: The document could not be read. It may be damaged or password protected.
codes.AI_DISABLED: AI is turned off for this workspace or not set up on this server.
codes.PLAN_IN_PROGRESS: A project is already being analyzed for you. Wait for it to finish or cancel it.
codes.AI_DAILY_LIMIT: This workspace has used all its AI project plans for today. Try again tomorrow.
codes.BAD_UPLOAD: The upload could not be read. Choose the file again.
codes.TARGET_INVALID: That project is not valid. Choose another project.
codes.TARGET_NOT_FOUND: That project no longer exists. Choose another project.
codes.TARGET_UNAVAILABLE: That project is no longer available. Choose another project or create a new one.
codes.TARGET_ARCHIVED: That project is archived. Choose another project or create a new one.

failure.AI_AUTH: The AI provider rejected the server key. Ask an administrator to check the configuration.
failure.AI_RATE_LIMIT: The AI provider is limiting requests or the account has no quota left. Try again later.
failure.AI_BAD_REQUEST: The AI provider refused the request, probably because the document is too long. Try a shorter document.
failure.AI_UNAVAILABLE: The AI provider is having problems. Try again in a few minutes.
failure.AI_TIMEOUT: The AI provider took too long to answer. Try again, or use a shorter document.
failure.AI_UNREACHABLE: The AI provider could not be reached. Try again later.
failure.AI_EMPTY: The AI provider returned an empty answer. Try again.
failure.AI_INVALID_OUTPUT: The AI did not return a usable plan twice in a row. Try again, or use a shorter document.
failure.AI_DISABLED: AI was turned off before the analysis started.
failure.STALE: The analysis did not finish and was stopped. Try again.
